name: Remix QuickPal
description:
QuickPal is a local on-demand delivery platform designed to make everyday shopping and deliveries faster, easier, and more convenient.

We connect customers, local stores, restaurants, grocery shops, and delivery partners on one platform.

🛒 What QuickPal Offers
🥦 Grocery & Daily Essentials – Fruits, vegetables, dairy products, snacks, beverages, household items and more.
🍔 Food & Fast Food Delivery – Vada Pav, Samosa, Waffles, snacks, meals, beverages and local food.
🏪 Local Store Delivery – Customers can order products from nearby grocery and other local stores.
📦 On-Demand Delivery – Fast pickup and doorstep delivery for eligible local orders.
🛵 Delivery Partner Network – Delivery partners can accept orders, pick up products and deliver them to customers.
💳 Multiple Payment Options – Online payment, UPI and Cash on Delivery.
📍 Local Delivery Focus – Serving customers and businesses within the selected service area.
👨‍💼 Business/Store Partner Support – Local shops can list their products and receive customer orders.
📊 Admin & Store Management – Order management, product/stock management, delivery partner management and order tracking.
